items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
items.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，称在网络安全领域实现“重大跃升”
items.summary: The Verge reports that Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, with gains in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity.

items.title: Routed Continual Learning
items.summary: Routed Continual Learning clusters past trajectories, gives each cluster its own memory system from a fixed library, and uses an LLM router to reuse or create a cluster before each run based on the problem statement and cluster summaries. On a stream interleaving 301 instances from six CL-Bench tasks with 97 banking instances from τ³-Bench, it raised normalized reward over a single global ICL history by 15–30% of the maximum attainable reward and cut estimated API cost by 65–72%.

items.title: Context Compaction for World Models
items.title_zh: 世界模型的上下文压缩
items.summary: The paper frames consistent world-model revisits as a context-retrieval problem, builds a benchmark that generates new worlds for every episode, and adds an agent harness that compacts context. Context compaction let the tested world models retrieve rooms up to four times beyond their context window without retraining, though models with sliding-window attention lost most of that retrieval when dreaming.

items.title: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
items.title_zh: 对齐自动研究：智能体与人类的共同改进
items.summary: The authors study how humans direct autoresearch agents in benchmark creation, finding people remain pivotal especially in the ideation phase, and introduce HackBench, which indicates current autoresearch agents are not aligned and cannot localize hacks well. They also train agents for better human interaction using human simulators during reinforcement learning and improve agent communication with expert-aligned rubrics.

items.title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
items.title_zh: HABIT-Bench：从纵向弱证据中评估智能体记忆的习惯归纳
items.summary: HABIT-Bench evaluates whether agent memory systems can infer user habits from partial, longitudinal evidence and apply them to later requests, using synthetic histories that span hundreds of sessions.

items.title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
items.title_zh: 学习科学轨迹以预测未来生物医学发现
items.summary: ForeSCITE clusters published biomedical conclusions, estimates a temporal direction within each cluster and projects conclusion embeddings along it, then decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses with an embedding language model. Across 407 clusters from about three million pre-cutoff conclusions, it increased semantic coverage, entity-pair novelty and post-cutoff pair re-observation over five baselines, and experts rated 37 prioritized CAR-T hypotheses as novel and biologically plausible.

items.title: Learning to Reason from Reference Samples Alone: Reinforced Adversarial Learning for Modern LLM Post-Training
items.title_zh: 仅凭参考样本学习推理：面向现代 LLM 后训练的强化对抗学习
items.summary: Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL) uses a co-trained LLM judge to turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training, avoiding explicit verifiable rewards. It matched direct RLVR on three verifiable tasks given sufficiently capable judges and enough training, and in scientific abstract generation its outputs were harder for human scientists and an LLM judge ensemble to distinguish from real abstracts than frontier-LLM baselines.

items.title: Quantum-Inspired Pairwise Ranking Aggregation via Active LLM Feedback
items.title_zh: 通过主动 LLM 反馈进行量子启发的成对排序聚合
items.summary: LLM-IRA extends quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation to document reranking, using an LLM only for pairwise judgments on high-disagreement pairs and producing a fast pointwise linear fusion of retriever scores. On BEIR and TREC Deep Learning benchmarks it matched or exceeded strong static fusion baselines on five of six benchmarks, reached significance over the best unsupervised aggregator on four, and required no training data or fine-tuning.

items.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
items.title_zh: Legora 正在构建法律工作的智能体操作系统
items.summary: Legora uses OpenAI models, ChatGPT and Codex to accelerate legal workflows, expand contract analysis and free lawyers to focus on higher-value work, according to OpenAI's customer post.
